name: aira-ai-tutor-frontend
description: Frontend-only AIra extraction (Landing + Tutor). No backend servers.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/landing && npm install --prefix apps/tutor --legacy-peer-deps && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/landing && npm run build --prefix apps/tutor
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/landing && npm run lint --prefix apps/tutor
